title: Transactional Data Change for Real-Time Analytics in Lakehouses
abstract: arXiv:2611.12169v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Real-time data analytics has become a key demand for lakehouses. It requires propagating data changes from the data source to the lakehouse in real time, while ensuring ACID guarantees and minimizing resource consumption and impact on analytical query performance. This is highly challenging for a data system according to the RUM conjecture, especially given the read-optimized immutable file storage layer in lakehouses. Existing lakehouses offer only git-style catalog version control on a single table, and they trade data freshness, query performance, and/or resource efficiency to achieve a barely acceptable data-change throughput. In this paper, we propose a novel data synchronization framework, Retina, that enables real-time, cost-efficient, query-performant, and fully transactional data changes in lakehouses. translated_title: 面向湖仓实时分析的事务性数据变更
translated_abstract: 实时数据分析已成为湖仓的关键需求。它要求将数据变更从数据源实时传播到湖仓，同时确保ACID保证，并最大限度地减少资源消耗以及对分析查询性能的影响。根据RUM猜想，这对数据系统而言极具挑战性，尤其是考虑到湖仓中采用读优化的不可变文件存储层。现有的湖仓仅提供针对单张表的git式目录版本控制，它们以牺牲数据新鲜度、查询性能和/或资源效率为代价，来实现勉强可接受的数据变更吞吐量。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的数据同步框架Retina，它在湖仓中实现实时、低成本、查询高性能且完全事务性的数据变更。我们实现并开源了Retina。评估表明，Retina可提供10毫秒级别的数据新鲜度和更优的性能表现。
tldr: 提出新型数据同步框架Retina，使湖仓能够实现实时、低成本、查询高性能且完全事务性的数据变更，达到10毫秒级数据新鲜度。
en_tdlr: Proposes Retina, a novel data synchronization framework that enables real-time, cost-efficient, query-performant, and fully transactional data changes in lakehouses with 10-millisecond-level data freshness.
